Issue Description: High voltage isolation warning detected during fast charging sequence
Root Cause: Moisture ingress in high voltage junction connector sealing gasket
Corrective Action: Replaced connector seal and cleared DTC history with calibration update

Issue Description: Cluster screen blacks out intermittently while riding at highway speeds
Root Cause: Loose CAN bus termination resistor connector near headstock harness
Corrective Action: Reseated harness and secured wiring clip with tie-wrap

Issue Description: Battery state-of-health mismatch between cell module 2 and module 5
Root Cause: Cell voltage imbalance caused by outdated BMS firmware v1.0.4 balancing schedule
Corrective Action: Updated BMS firmware to v1.2.1 and performed 100% slow balance cycle

Issue Description: Customer mobile application unable to fetch live SoC and vehicle location
Root Cause: Telematics SIM eSIM authentication timeout with cellular network provider
Corrective Action: Re-provisioned eSIM profile via OTA portal and reset TCU module

Issue Description: Vehicle jerking under hard acceleration above 40 km/h
Root Cause: Motor controller resolver sensor offset calibration drift
Corrective Action: Performed resolver angle auto-calibration in service diagnostic mode

Issue Description: 12V auxiliary battery draining overnight when vehicle is parked
Root Cause: Auxiliary DC-DC converter quiescent sleep current exceeded 15mA specification
Corrective Action: Replaced DC-DC auxiliary converter sub-assembly under warranty
